role.title: Senior Software Engineer
role.domain: Java software development and big data

responsibilities: Develop software using Java and Java EE.
Build web-based applications and REST services with the Spring Framework.

Apply professional software engineering practices throughout the software development lifecycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control, continuous delivery, testing, and operations.
Use object-oriented programming, design patterns, test-driven development, and unit testing.
Work within Agile frameworks such as Scrum and Kanban.
Contribute to software development in the big data field.
companyTone: Professional and enthusiastic, with a direct focus on technical qualifications and engineering practices.
extractionNotes: The company name, employment type, and work mode are not provided.
The posting requires at least five years of Java and Java EE development experience.
A separate minimum of three years of Spring Framework experience is stated.
A BSc degree in Computer Engineering or a relevant engineering or computer science field is required.
Big Data technologies are presented as an area of passion rather than a clearly stated hands-on technical requirement, so they are classified as preferred.
